steps.name: Mirror's Memory Fragment
steps.objective: Check your past memories in front of the place where Belial was, and click the [Quest Complete] button to end the quest.

lines.text: (Devesis's past, of which time is unknown, vague memories of that time flow in.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: There are guys like you in Creed. Their mental power is stronger than those in the demon world.
I have made up my mind, demon Belial.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Is this the only way you can summon a high-ranking demon and ask for a favor?
Wow... . Okay… . All right. Wow.
Everything, I will do as you wish. Belial.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Yeah? okay.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: This time, I won't specifically take your soul. It couldn't get any better than this when you showed up.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Come inside this mirror. There will be the ancestor god ‘Ignor’ that you have been waiting for.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Go and meet me.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: I wasn't sure what would happen next to the person who killed God, but it's good.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: I don't know what you mean, but you will be killing your ancestral spirit that I imprisoned a long time ago. This mirror is made that way.
No way, you called me here... .

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Hehe, unfortunately I didn't see it at that time. I'll be watching you from here.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Are you okay, Talos?

steps.name: an unexpected connection
steps.objective: Visit [Racelis] in “Devesis” to check the story, and click the [Quest Complete] button to end the quest.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: I heard you're really pretty.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Chef, are you talking about me?

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: No. What makes you think Ms. Patelo is pretty?

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Then me? me?

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Shubie is cute.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Hehe, thank you.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Juri Ling, the chef says you’re pretty.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Thank you. Chef. ring.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: He said he helped us with our work. Whenever you're hungry, come here and eat under my name.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Really? ring? Can I really come and eat it all? ring?

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Have you been deceived?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Wow, long live Patel. ring.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: As expected, he is a guy who can communicate well.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Juri Ling, let’s go to the gem mine together to find gems later. It'll be fun.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Oh, great. ring. Let's go play together. ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard that Juriring's wish was to eat with the people of Devesis village... . It really happened that way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But when there is such a big freeling, why aren’t people surprised?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I… . %s, it’s been a while… are you.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: %s, that is. There are a lot of eccentric wizards researching at the tower, so there are a lot of incidents.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: That's why it doesn't feel like a big problem even when Juri Ring appears... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Mr. Patelo once showed me that he had made a cooking assistant golem, but it went berserk and destroyed the store.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Then, Mr. Patelo imbued the gem processing machine with magical energy to make it move, and the gem fragments rose into the sky over Devesis and exploded like fireworks.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Also, Mr. Patel... .

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Now that I think about it, Mr. Patelo… .

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Why is Uncle Patelo in every accident?

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Hahahaha. Isn’t this the fate of a genius wizard? I wasn't the only one who got into an accident!

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Phew, reflect on yourself. Mr. Patel.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Yes, teacher.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I… . %s. hey.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Elliot? Elliot, it’s been a while.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Hello… . %s… . You are here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where have you been all this time? I was worried because I suddenly couldn't see it.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you go to the monster habitat again?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: %s, we know each other. nice to meet you I am Martha, the chief of Devesis.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I'm Elliot... .

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Wow… . You look so pretty... . My name is Shuvier.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Oh, no. Shu and Shuvie are prettier.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Hey… It looks like the road to Linford has disappeared... Did you know… ?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I can't see the way from Whispering Hill... .

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Linford?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Aaaah, big, big freeling!!

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: This is Juri Ring. ring.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Wait, did you say Linford? One of those pieces of heaven?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Elliot, Linford over there... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Patelo and Marta, why are you surprised?

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: That's it... .

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Oh, I know that 'Linford'. ring! Cursed 10 years ago... … … .
